\caption{Refined hybrid surrogate architecture. The temporal surrogate predicts the current reduced spatial state $\hat{\mathbf{s}}_j$. A separate instantaneous reactivity head predicts $\hat{\rho}_j$ from the predicted current multigroup flux state and the current control drum angle $\theta_j$. The predicted reactivity drives a higher-order implicit PKE solve, advancing the kinetics state from $\mathbf{y}_{j-1}$ to $\mathbf{y}_j=(n_j,\mathbf{c}_j)$. The predicted spatial state and solved kinetics state are then assembled into the next autoregressive hybrid state.}
\label{fig:refined_hybrid_surrogate_architecture}
\end{figure*}
